* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Working knowledge of motor control fundamentals, including feedback control loops, encoders, and current sensing.
* Familiarity with functional safety principles and the ability to translate safety requirements into software constraints.

* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) such as QNX, and fluency across the RTOS/Linux boundary on multi-core MCU/CPU platforms.
* Experience with embedded communication interfaces such as CAN / CAN FD, EtherCAT, SPI, I2C, and RS-485.
